label: after-profile
method: Fresh page per sample; 120 warm-up then exactly 600 measured fixed steps. Same seed/input/quality, no concurrent browser tests. Frame intervals measured postrender-to-postrender (not GPU timings). Engine includes synchronous effect event handlers. renderSubmit includes graphicsRender. Instrumented/profiled runs are separate from unprofiled comparison. Local one-device synthetic load, not player feedback.
